name: Vincent Dracula
source:
The son of Dracula, Vincent dreads the idea of living in his father's shadow and does everything in his power to antagonize him.

An incorrigible flirt, he enjoys using his charm to get what he wants. Unfortunately for Vincent, his complete lack of respect for boundaries tends to get him into all kinds of trouble.

[From [url=http://monstrousloversevn.tumblr.com/characters]official site[/url]]
